_comment: Gemma-2-9B-it FULL fine-tune on 1x A100 80GB — memory-tight, optimized for ~6 hour completion
_hardware_notes: Gemma-2-9B has ~9B params — larger than Qwen (7.6B) and Llama (8B)
Memory is TIGHT: model+optimizer ~72GB in bf16, leaves ~8GB for activations
batch_size=2 is the safe maximum with gradient checkpointing
Lower LR (1e-5) — Gemma 2 benefits from conservative learning rate
Effective batch size: 1 GPU x 2 batch x 8 accum = 16
Full 1 epoch = ~9,264 steps (148K / 16) ≈ ~10 hours on A100
REQUIRES: huggingface-cli login (Gemma is a gated model)
If OOM: reduce max_length to 384 or use LoRA config instead
